failure.title: Lighthouse extractor rejected a valid serialized loaded-state audit
failure.note: The recurring /queue loaded-state abort is retained with the complete parseable raw Lighthouse result, an exact normalized diagnostic and stack, the redacted failure container log, safe-teardown log, and empty post-teardown container, volume, and network inventories. The raw result reports performance 0.94, accessibility 1.00, a score-1 spotter-loaded-state audit, and exact visible valid h1 heading proof for Review queue, with no runtime error or run warnings.
failure.diagnosis: The extractor required audit.numericValue to equal 1 even though Lighthouse's serialized LHR omitted numericValue while retaining score 1 and the exact validated loaded-state proof. The application page and custom audit succeeded; the harness rejected a valid raw report because it depended on a field that is not preserved by the serialization boundary.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
